Around [[3640 BBY]] a '''guild''' on [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] asked the Sarkhai representative in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Nadia Grell]] for permission from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to demolish the [[Annex of Kespan]], the oldest ruin on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and build a new [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on its site.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sarkhai guild is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Nadia Grell companion storyline. The decision on whether to preserve or demolish the ruin is made by the player, who suggests the solution to Nadia.<ref name="SWTOR" />
